entities.summary: Paula Karina Masotta Biagetti is a retired field hockey player from Argentina, who won the silver medal with the national field hockey team at the 2000 Summer Olympics. She also won the Champions Trophy in 2001, the 2002 World Cup, the Pan American Cup in 2001 and three Pan American Games.
